articles.author: David M. Jackson
articles.headline: Netflix's Post-Earnings Selloff: Trapped By Its Own Success
articles.summary:
Netflix just delivered the kind of quarter most CEOs would frame on their wall. Revenue up. Margins healthy. Strategy firing on all cylinders. Etc. 



And the market’s response? A selloff.



To the casual observer, it
articles._summary: Netflix just delivered the kind of quarter most CEOs would frame on their wall. Revenue up. Margins healthy. Strategy firing on all cylinders. Etc. To the casual observer, it looks like insanity. But seasoned players understand something darker at work here: a brutal logic that governs not just stocks, but power itself: The crowd doesn’t judge you by your performance. It judges you by the story it already told itself about you. Netflix didn’t stumble. It simply failed to outrun its own legend. Netflix the business is objectively stronger today than it was three months ago. Both statements are true. The disconnect exists because you’re not buying a company when you click “buy”. Instead, you’re buying a future that may or may not arrive. And that future was already priced for perfection. When a company makes excellence look routine, the market stops rewarding it for excellence. It starts demanding miracles.
articles._zh_headline: Netflix 的财报后抛售：受困于自身的成功

articles._zh_headline: 苹果、美光、火箭公司等出现在 CNBC 的“最终交易”中
articles._zh_summary: 周四，有报道称美国众议院委员会敦促特朗普政府禁止中国存储芯片，这可能会破坏现有的供应链，因此内存相关公司的股价周四走低。 Capital Area Planning Group 的管理合伙人 Malcolm Ethridge 选择了 Rocket Companies, Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：RKT）。

articles.author: Shomik Sen Bhattacharjee
articles.headline: SpaceX Buying Tesla at Current Valuations Would Not ‘Pass Muster,’ Gary Black Says as SPCX Retreats From Post-IPO Highs
articles.summary: Future Fund Managing Director Gary Black disagrees with speculation of SpaceX acquiring Tesla, citing fiduciary duty.
articles._summary: "Those who think $SPCX will buy $TSLA don’t understand the concept of board fiduciary duty," Black wrote on X. Black put Musk’s control at 82% of SpaceX’s voting power and 42% of its equity. SpaceX’s prospectus shows Musk retained overwhelming voting control, including power to elect the board, while public shareholders have limited influence over corporate decisions. "That doesn’t magically let the SPCX board off the fiduciary hook," Black said.
articles._zh_headline: 加里·布莱克 (Gary Black) 表示，随着 SPCX 从 IPO 后高点回落，SpaceX 以当前估值收购特斯拉不会“通过考验”
articles._zh_summary: 布莱克在 X 上写道：“那些认为 $SPCX 会收购 $TSLA 的人不理解董事会信托义务的概念。”布莱克认为马斯克控制着 SpaceX 82% 的投票权和 42% 的股权。 SpaceX的招股说明书显示，马斯克保留了压倒性的投票控制权，包括选举董事会的权力，而公众股东对公司决策的影响力有限。 “这并没有神奇地让 SPCX 董事会摆脱信托的束缚，”布莱克说。

articles.author: Anusuya Lahiri
articles.headline: NVIDIA Could Be the Missing Piece in Japan's AI Puzzle: Analyst
articles.summary: Analysts back NVIDIA's massive AI push in Japan, predicting NVDA will center the country's emerging sovereign AI ecosystem.
articles._summary: Following NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang’s visit to Tokyo, Counterpoint analyst Marc Einstein said Japan has lagged regional peers in AI development despite significant government support for semiconductors. However, he believes the country’s strategy is beginning to broaden beyond chips.
articles._zh_headline: 分析师：NVIDIA 可能是日本人工智能难题中缺失的一块
articles._zh_summary: 在 NVIDIA 首席执行官黄仁勋访问东京后，Counterpoint 分析师 Marc Einstein 表示，尽管政府对半导体给予大力支持，但日本在人工智能发展方面仍落后于地区同行。然而，他相信该国的战略正开始扩展到芯片以外的领域。
